title: AIAS Context Engine
purpose: Provide a repository-derived, versioned and integrity-protected continuity authority for AIAS.
scope: Context inventory, roadmap reconciliation, snapshots, integrity validation and continuity artifacts.

requirements.title: Repository context
requirements.statement: ACE shall derive the current project state from the active repository.
requirements.rationale: Prevent stale chat summaries from becoming project authority.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Versioned snapshots
requirements.statement: ACE shall create a versioned context snapshot after each build.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Integrity
requirements.statement: ACE shall protect the canonical context with SHA-256 integrity validation.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Roadmap reconciliation
requirements.statement: ACE shall reconcile completed components and the next formal program.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Continuity artifacts
requirements.statement: ACE shall generate machine-readable and human-readable continuity artifacts.
requirements.rationale: Allow reliable transfer between conversations and models.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
